docs.summary: Fluent builder for an accordion: a stack of collapsible sections where opening one collapses the others (single-open). Each section is an Origami [`FoldoutBuilder`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.FoldoutBuilder) under the hood. Construct via [`Accordion`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~Accordion), add sections, then call [`Show`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.AccordionBuilder~Show).
docs.remarks: The open section is tracked per-instance in element storage, so the caller holds no state. Pass [`AllowAllClosed`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.AccordionBuilder~AllowAllClosed) = false to keep exactly one section open at all times.
